run_metric: run the metric function to print all OOD detection metrics for a given neural network and dataset
run_tpr95: run the tpr95 function to calculate FPR at 95% TPR for baseline and our method
run_auroc: run the auroc function to calculate AUROC scores for baseline and our method
run_auprIn: run the auprIn function to calculate AUPR for in-distribution data on baseline and our method
run_auprOut: run the auprOut function to calculate AUPR for out-of-distribution data on baseline and our method
